After recruiting [Dean Domino](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/sierra-madre?locationIds=487648) and killing a Ghost, he'll reference Army of Darkness (1992) by saying ["He's not dead... It's a trick. Get an axe."](https://youtu.be/lxFOVtr9fbk?si=ayjlEVC22wnBmKS9)

locations.title: Doctor Who reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

Underground, you'll find 'I AM NOT YOUR MUMMY' written on a pillar. This is a reference to an excellent Doctor Who two-parter, 'The Empty Child / The Doctor Dances', where a child wearing a gas mask frequently asks ["Are you my mummy?"](https://youtu.be/K91dLbiHR14?si=pEWJNpFK-Kpxhx7B)
